tagline.zh: 共同区域的具象化:一条边框或一层底色把相关内容圈成一块,头部标题 + 正文 + 操作区 + 可选封面,是信息分区最基本的容器。
tagline.en: Common region made concrete: one border or one fill circles related content into a block — header + body + actions + optional cover, the most basic container for partitioning information.

origin.zh: 规格对齐 Ant Design Card(antd 6.7.1,经 out/design-study/06-antdesign.md §4.18 + 本地 `.scratch/antd06` 源码复核):size 默认 medium(index.zh-CN.md:55)、hoverable 默认 false(Card.Grid 内默认 true,:52、:68)、variant 默认 outlined(取代 v5 bordered=true,:47)、cover 为 ReactNode 内容插槽(:49);分组语义参考格式塔·共同区域法则(调研 07§35)。
origin.en: Spec aligned with Ant Design Card (antd 6.7.1, verified via out/design-study/06-antdesign.md §4.18 plus the local `.scratch/antd06` source): size defaults to medium (index.zh-CN.md:55), hoverable to false (true inside Card.Grid, :52/:68), variant to outlined (replacing v5 bordered=true, :47), and cover is a ReactNode slot (:49); grouping semantics follow the Law of Common Region (research 07 §35).

effect.zh: JS 型参数(demo 订阅后切换 data-size)。对齐 antd Card size 默认 medium(index.zh-CN.md:55,分档 medium|small);demo 两档的内边距具体像素(24px / 12px)为演示值,antd 的 Card 头部/正文 padding 像素规格调研未记载(未证实)。
effect.en: JS-type param (demo subscribes and toggles data-size). Aligned with antd Card size defaulting to medium (index.zh-CN.md:55, tiers medium|small); the demo tiers' concrete paddings (24px / 12px) are demo values — antd's pixel specs for Card head/body padding aren't recorded in the research (unverified).

effect.zh: JS 型参数(demo 订阅后切换 data-hoverable)。antd hoverable 默认 false(index.zh-CN.md:52);唯一例外是 Card.Grid 内默认 true(:68)。浮起 = 阴影从轻阴影档升到浮层阴影档,demo 采用 antd boxShadowTertiary → boxShadow 两组实测 token(06-antdesign.md §2.3 ⑥)。
effect.en: JS-type param (demo subscribes and toggles data-hoverable). antd hoverable defaults to false (index.zh-CN.md:52); the one exception is inside Card.Grid where it defaults to true (:68). Lifting = shadow rises from the tertiary tier to the elevation tier; the demo uses antd's measured boxShadowTertiary → boxShadow token pair (06-antdesign.md §2.3 ⑥).

effect.zh: JS 型参数(demo 订阅后渲染顶部色带)。antd cover 是内容插槽(ReactNode,默认 -,index.zh-CN.md:49)——存在与否由内容决定,没有布尔默认;demo 以渐变色带模拟封面,off 为演示默认值。
effect.en: JS-type param (demo subscribes and renders the top color band). antd cover is a content slot (ReactNode, no default, index.zh-CN.md:49) — its presence is decided by content, so no boolean default exists; the demo simulates the cover with a gradient band, and off is the demo default.

note.zh: 本条目仅用 div + CSS(边框、底色、box-shadow、transition),全浏览器基线能力,无特性开关要适配;box-shadow 多层阴影与过渡在 2015 年后的所有常青浏览器一致。
note.en: This entry uses only div + CSS (borders, fills, box-shadow, transition) — baseline in every browser, nothing to feature-detect; multi-layer shadows and transitions behave consistently across all evergreen browsers since ~2015.

fallback.zh: 卡片没有需要降级的视觉特性;要做的是层级降级:不支持(或不需要)阴影时保留 1px 边框定义边界(outlined 形态),暗色环境下阴影失效时用底色微差区分层级——antd dark 算法正是用 lighten 底色替代阴影(06-antdesign.md §2.4)。
fallback.en: The card has no visual feature to degrade; degrade hierarchy instead: when shadows are unsupported (or unwanted), keep a 1px border to define the boundary (the outlined form), and in dark environments where shadows vanish, separate levels by subtle fill differences — antd's dark algorithm replaces shadows with lightened fills exactly this way (06-antdesign.md §2.4).

use.zh: 栅格中的信息分区:仪表盘统计卡、设置分组、内容流单元(卡片 = 格式塔共同区域,调研 07§35)
use.en: Partitioning information in grids: dashboard stat cards, settings groups, feed units (card = Gestalt common region, research 07 §35)

use.zh: 带封面的内容卡:文章/商品/媒体预览,cover 承载图片区,actions 承载操作区
use.en: Covered content cards: article/product/media previews where cover holds the image area and actions the footer controls

use.zh: 需要 hover 预告「整块可点」的可点击单元(hoverable),点击进入详情
use.en: Clickable units where hover previews 'the whole block is tappable' (hoverable), leading to a detail page

avoid.zh: 卡片套卡片的多层嵌套——共同区域边界互相打架,层级反而模糊
avoid.en: Cards nested inside cards — competing common-region boundaries blur hierarchy instead of clarifying it

avoid.zh: 一屏十几个同权重卡片——每张卡都在喊「看我」,分区价值随数量归零;先分组再分区
avoid.en: A dozen equal-weight cards per screen — every card shouts 'look at me' and partitioning value drops to zero; group first, then partition

avoid.zh: 不可点击的静态卡开 hoverable——虚假 affordance 诱导点击;只有整卡可点才浮起
avoid.en: hoverable on static, non-clickable cards — a false affordance inviting clicks; only lift cards that are entirely clickable

a11y.zh: 卡片是布局容器不是控件:不要给容器加 role="button"——可点击性属于卡内真实的按钮/链接;整卡可点时,确保键盘有等价路径(卡内放一个覆盖全卡的真链接),hover 浮起只是视觉预告;标题用语义层级(h2/h3)组织,操作区按钮带可读文本(图标按钮补 aria-label);边框/阴影边界保持 3:1 非文本对比(WCAG 2.1 SC 1.4.11)。
a11y.en: A card is a layout container, not a control: never put role="button" on the container — clickability belongs to the real buttons/links inside; when the whole card is clickable, guarantee a keyboard path (one real link stretched over the card) — the hover lift is only a visual preview; structure titles with semantic heading levels (h2/h3) and give action buttons readable text (icon buttons get aria-label); borders/shadows keep 3:1 non-text contrast (WCAG 2.1 SC 1.4.11).

goal.zh: 复刻一张内容卡:头部(标题 + extra 操作)+ 正文 + 底部操作区,可选顶部渐变封面带,hoverable 时阴影从轻阴影档升至浮层阴影档并微微上浮,sm/md 两档密度。
goal.en: Replicate a content card: header (title + extra action) + body + footer action row, an optional top gradient cover band, and when hoverable a shadow rising from the tertiary tier to the elevation tier with a slight lift, in sm/md density tiers.

acceptance.zh: 默认形态:1px 边框(outlined)、无阴影浮起、无封面、md 密度——四项与参数快照一致
acceptance.en: Default form: 1px border (outlined), no shadow lift, no cover, md density — all four matching the parameter snapshot

acceptance.zh: hoverable=on 的浮起用 antd boxShadowTertiary → boxShadow 两组 token,过渡 0.2s easeOut
acceptance.en: hoverable=on lifts with antd's boxShadowTertiary → boxShadow token pair, transitioning 0.2s easeOut

acceptance.zh: cover=on 时顶部渲染渐变色带(纯装饰 aria-hidden),头部/正文/操作区结构不变
acceptance.en: cover=on renders a gradient band on top (purely decorative aria-hidden) without changing header/body/actions structure

acceptance.zh: sm/md 只改内边距与标题字号,边框/阴影/结构不随 size 漂移
acceptance.en: sm/md changes only padding and title size; border/shadow/structure never drift with size

acceptance.zh: 容器不加 role="button";操作区按钮带可读文本,hover 浮起配合 prefers-reduced-motion 关闭过渡
acceptance.en: No role="button" on the container; action buttons carry readable text; the hover lift transition disables under prefers-reduced-motion
